description: Lets a removals business send customer email from its own domain through Movers App (delivered by Postmark): a DKIM signing key and a custom Return-Path for bounce handling.
variableDescription: %dkimselector%: DKIM selector Postmark issued for the domain (e.g. 20260903124811pm); %dkimkey%: base64 DKIM public key Postmark issued for the domain (the p= value)
